data.one_liner: WYSIWYG rich text editor widget for Flutter using a WebView.
data.what_it_does: Provides a rich‑text editing surface with formatting, lists, images, videos, links and more. Content can be retrieved or set as HTML or Tiptap/ProseMirror JSON. A customizable toolbar and theming support are included.
use_when: You need a full‑featured rich‑text editor on Android/iOS
You want HTML/JSON output and a customizable toolbar
You need RTL support and theme‑aware styling
avoid_when: You require a pure‑Dart editor without a WebView
You target web or desktop platforms
You need a minimal bundle size
strengths: Follows app theme and supports RTL
weaknesses: Depends on flutter_inappwebview, increasing app size
data.setup_notes: Configure flutter_inappwebview and image_picker per their docs, add iOS photo library usage description and NSAllowsLocalNetworking in Info.plist, ensure Android System WebView 80+ is available.
